changes.to: Maker specifications panel: speed ~2-5 m/s (recorded as the 5 m/s top of the range), payload 10 kg, weight 25 kg minus payload, range 8-10 km, LTE and RF communication, endurance ~120 min. No test conditions are attached to the figures. The maker markets it as India's first armed quadruped and accepts inquiries/customisation; no deliveries are public.
Indian armed quadruped UGV for defence, border patrol and hazardous industrial inspection, carrying 10 kg of payload over LTE and RF links.
